notes.title: Huge and New Update! - Cards and Guns
notes.notes:
Hello community,

Another update with additions, fixes and revisions.

Many of the changes are thanks to feedback from our playtesting period on Gameround.

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
Family Devs.

[h2]Cards and Guns - 0.6.0[/h2]

[h3]ADDED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Two new game modes.
[*] New achievements.
[*] New music.
[*] New backgrounds/biomes.
[*] New loot.
[*] Destructible objects.
[*] Global leaderboard.
[*] Auto aim toggle in the Settings menu.
[*] VFX when the player takes damage.
[*] VFX when the player dies.
[*] At the end of the wave, the resources come to the player.
[*] Bosses and Elites drop better loot.
[/list]

[h3]UPDATED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now the "Select controls" menu is no longer displayed. The game automatically detects the controls according to the player's behaviour.
[*] Player and enemy collision box.
[*] HP are not reset at the start of a new wave.
[*] Difficulty.
[*] The reroll price in shops is reset every time you finish a wave.
[*] Improved menus.
[*] Behaviour of some cards.
[*] Improvements in the translation into Spanish and Catalan.
[/list]

[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] A bug that causes the music to stop.
[*] Several minor issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.1.3 - Cards and Guns
notes.notes:
[h2]Cards and Guns - 0.1.3[/h2]

[h3]ADDED[/h3]

[list]
[*] New language: Brazilian Portuguese.
[*] New menu: Credits
[*] Accessibility options: an option has been added in the Settings menu to change the font.
[*] An option in the Settings menu to hide blood when killing enemies.
[*] Cards Shop: It is now indicated which stats will be upgraded before the upgrade is purchased. 
[*] A progress bar while a card is active, to make the player aware of how long the effect of a card remains.
[/list]

[h3]UPDATED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Boss “Wizard” stats.
[*] Card “Electric shot” stats.
[/list]


[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] A bug when playing the game on a Steam Deck.
[*] A bug when leveling up bullet damage.
[*] You have zero health points but you don't die.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
We are so proud to announce the [b]demo[/b] of our new game: [b]Cards and Guns[/b]!

[previewyoutube=haTw1bwyGHE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Cards and Guns[/b] is a top-down arena shooter roguelite, where you’ll have to defeat hordes of creatures. Choose from a variety of cards and upgrades to create unique builds and survive to the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43860982/5fd5ecc9712de4c86534dba10bc21b07d8a84f60.jpg[/img]

This demo is a sneak peak of [b]Cards and Guns[/b], to show you how gameplay works, some mechanics and art of our game. Most of the content is under development and therefore locked, but we hope you can feel its potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43860982/8a59db0201cfe161ae1603aa70f8dd4f98130b8a.jpg[/img]

Play the [b]demo[/b] and add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] to support the development of the game!

Family Devs.
